doc.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Marriage to singer Madeline Eastman
summary: He is married to singer Madeline Eastman.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I’m going to milk it, believe me. You know I’m married to a musician, I’m married to a singer. I don’t know if you knew that, Madeline Eastman, a real good singer. And that works good. We are not the typical husband-wife work together all the time you know. We do but we don’t and it works fine. We keep it that way. Like a lot of husband wife teams are the Bickersons on stage, you know what I mean? “It’s too fast, it’s too slow, wrong key.” We get a kick out of that.
